core_principles: Objective, rigid, and functional. Purely designed for high-stakes operational environments.
Density without clutter: Use the 'Control Room Grid' (Mode B). Every pixel utilized.
Color is Function Only: 95% of UI is monochrome. Color exists only to indicate status (Online, Offline, Alert, Recording).
Optical Alignment over Geometrical: Data must align perfectly for rapid scanning by operators.

headings.usage: Use for widget titles, numerical KPI highlights, and system status headers. Do not use generic sans.

body.usage: Use for dense data tables, logs, settings menus, and tooltips.

mono.usage: Crucial for tabular data, IPs, MAC addresses, timestamps, and license plates (ANPR).

layout.surfaces: Grid Borders (The 'Technical' Look). border-collapse style layouts for widgets. 1px borders, NO DROP SHADOWS.

video_wall.structure: Dynamic CSS grid based on selection (grid-cols-1 up to grid-cols-8).
video_wall.camera_feed: Relative container, absolute overlay for Camera Name, Timestamp (Mono font), and Red Recording Dot. Hover reveals PTZ controls.

data_tables.style: Highly condensed, border-b only for rows, text-sm or text-xs.
data_tables.anpr_list: Display license plate in a stylized Badge (resembling physical plate), timestamp, camera location, and site.

navigation.sidebar: Left-aligned, icon-heavy with collapsable text. Active state uses border-l-2 border-active_blue and bg-surface_hover.
navigation.topbar: System health metrics (CPU, RAM, Storage) displayed as mini sparklines or percentage bars, plus global Alert center dropdown.

icons.instructions: Use sharp, technical icons. Fill icons only when representing an 'active/recording' state.

image_urls.description: PTZ security camera on pole - Use as placeholder for camera stream 1
Street CCTV camera - Use as placeholder for camera stream 2
Mercedes Benz with license plate - Use for ANPR vehicle search result / timeline thumbnail
License Plate close-up - Use for ANPR log details

instructions_to_main_agent: CRITICAL: ALL interactive elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case based on role (e.g., data-testid='login-submit-button', data-testid='camera-grid-4x4').

LAYOUT: Build the app exactly like a high-end control room dashboard. Minimal whitespace between widgets (use gap-2 or gap-4). Fill the screen height (h-screen, overflow-hidden on body, independent scrolling areas).
THEME: Ensure robust dark and light mode support via Tailwind class strategy. Default to dark mode if possible.
COMPONENTS: Use Shadcn UI extensively for Dialogs, Selects, and Tabs. Override border-radius to be rounded-none or rounded-sm to maintain the 'Swiss Brutalist/Technical' feel.
FONTS: Install and use 'Chivo' (Google Font) for headers/numbers, 'IBM Plex Sans' for body, and 'IBM Plex Mono' for IPs/timestamps/plates.

VIDEO WALL: Construct the video grid using pure CSS Grid (e.g., className={`grid grid-cols-${Math.sqrt(cameras)} gap-1`}). Overlay camera name, status dot, and timestamp absolute positioned inside the feed.
STATUS: Use neon/high-contrast colors strictly for status (Green = Online, Red = Offline/Alert). The rest of the UI must remain monochrome to let the video feeds and alerts stand out.
